subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Pandemic Preparedness
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Pandemic Preparedness.

hook.text: COVID killed millions and cost $16 trillion. Scientists warn the next pandemic could be worse. Are we ready? No.

buildup.text: Pandemic preparedness requires early detection systems, stockpiled supplies, and pre-planned response protocols.

discovery.text: The WHO is negotiating a Pandemic Treaty to improve global coordination, but major countries resist binding commitments.

twist.text: COVID's lessons are already fading. Pandemic funding has been cut. Political will for preparedness has evaporated.

climax.text: Pandemics are inevitable. Preparation is a choice. The world is choosing poorly.

punchline.text: COVID cost $16 trillion. Next pandemic: funding cut. Not ready.

quiz.question: What is the current state of global pandemic preparedness?
options: Funding has been cut and political will has evaporated
The world is fully prepared for the next pandemic
A binding international treaty is in place
